objective: Make the fake test checkout unreachable in production and on any environment that has not explicitly opted in.
userOutcome: Members can no longer grant themselves cruush+, including the lifetime founder plan, without paying.
audience: cruush members and Julien as operator.
successCriteria: The fake checkout refuses unless explicitly enabled
Production refuses to boot with it enabled
Local development still works when opted in
mustPreserve: Local development can still exercise the entitlement path
Real checkout and entitlement behaviour is unchanged
nonGoals: No change to pricing, plans, or the crypto rail

assumptions.statement: 404 is the right response rather than 403, so the route does not advertise itself.
assumptions.impact: A caller cannot distinguish a disabled feature from a missing one.

nextVisibleMilestone: The fix is deployed to production and the bypass no longer works there.
stopConditions: Any step would deploy without explicit approval
requiredEvidence: Focused tests prove the guard refuses and that production rejects the configuration
environmentChanges: BILLING_TEST_CHECKOUT_ENABLED is new, server-only, false by default, and must never be true in production
task: Close a live payment bypass: the fake checkout granted cruush+ with no payment to any authenticated member.
decisions: Both halves of the fake checkout are gated, because session creation hardcodes the exact fields completion checks
Production refuses to boot rather than merely refusing the request
proof: 5 focused guard tests, existing billing and config tests, typecheck, copy check.
